work.title: The Third Part of King Henry the Sixth
work.author: William Shakespeare

content.text: Flourish. Enter King Henry, Queen Margaret, the Prince of Wales, Clifford and Northumberland with drums and trumpets.

lines.text: Welcome, my lord, to this brave town of York.
lines.plainText: Welcome my lord to this brave town of York

lines.text: Yonder's the head of that arch-enemy
lines.plainText: Yonder's the head of that archenemy

lines.text: That sought to be encompassed with your crown.
lines.plainText: That sought to be encompassed with your crown

lines.text: Doth not the object cheer your heart, my lord?
lines.plainText: Doth not the object cheer your heart my lord

lines.text: Ay, as the rocks cheer them that fear their wrack!
lines.plainText: Ay as the rocks cheer them that fear their wrack

lines.text: To see this sight, it irks my very soul.
lines.plainText: To see this sight it irks my very soul

lines.text: Withhold revenge, dear God! 'Tis not my fault,
lines.plainText: Withhold revenge dear God 'Tis not my fault

lines.text: Nor wittingly have I infringed my vow.
lines.plainText: Nor wittingly have I infringed my vow

lines.text: My gracious liege, this too much lenity
lines.plainText: My gracious liege this too much lenity

lines.text: And harmful pity must be laid aside.
lines.plainText: And harmful pity must be laid aside

lines.text: To whom do lions cast their gentle looks?
lines.plainText: To whom do lions cast their gentle looks

lines.text: Not to the beast that would usurp their den.
lines.plainText: Not to the beast that would usurp their den

lines.text: Whose hand is that the forest bear doth lick?
lines.plainText: Whose hand is that the forest bear doth lick

lines.text: Not his that spoils her young before her face.
lines.plainText: Not his that spoils her young before her face

lines.text: Who scapes the lurking serpent's mortal sting?
lines.plainText: Who scapes the lurking serpent's mortal sting

lines.text: Not he that sets his foot upon her back.
lines.plainText: Not he that sets his foot upon her back

lines.text: The smallest worm will turn, being trodden on,
lines.plainText: The smallest worm will turn being trodden on

lines.text: And doves will peck in safeguard of their brood.
lines.plainText: And doves will peck in safeguard of their brood

lines.text: Ambitious York did level at thy crown,
lines.plainText: Ambitious York did level at thy crown

lines.text: Thou smiling while he knit his angry brows.
lines.plainText: Thou smiling while he knit his angry brows

lines.text: He, but a duke, would have his son a king,
lines.plainText: He but a duke would have his son a king

lines.text: And raise his issue like a loving sire;
lines.plainText: And raise his issue like a loving sire

lines.text: Thou, being a king, blest with a goodly son,
lines.plainText: Thou being a king blest with a goodly son

lines.text: Didst yield consent to disinherit him,
lines.plainText: Didst yield consent to disinherit him

lines.text: Which argued thee a most unloving father.
lines.plainText: Which argued thee a most unloving father

lines.text: Unreasonable creatures feed their young;
lines.plainText: Unreasonable creatures feed their young

lines.text: And though man's face be fearful to their eyes,
lines.plainText: And though man's face be fearful to their eyes

lines.text: Yet, in protection of their tender ones,
lines.plainText: Yet in protection of their tender ones

lines.text: Who hath not seen them, even with those wings
lines.plainText: Who hath not seen them even with those wings

lines.text: Which sometime they have used with fearful flight,
lines.plainText: Which sometime they have used with fearful flight

lines.text: Make war with him that climbed unto their nest,
lines.plainText: Make war with him that climbed unto their nest

lines.text: Offering their own lives in their young's defence?
lines.plainText: Offering their own lives in their young's defence

lines.text: For shame, my liege, make them your precedent.
lines.plainText: For shame my liege make them your precedent

lines.text: Were it not pity that this goodly boy
lines.plainText: Were it not pity that this goodly boy

lines.text: Should lose his birthright by his father's fault,
lines.plainText: Should lose his birthright by his father's fault

lines.text: And long hereafter say unto his child,
lines.plainText: And long hereafter say unto his child

lines.text: "What my great-grandfather and grandsire got,
lines.plainText: What my greatgrandfather and grandsire got

lines.text: My careless father fondly gave away?"
lines.plainText: My careless father fondly gave away

lines.text: Ah, what a shame were this! Look on the boy,
lines.plainText: Ah what a shame were this Look on the boy

lines.text: And let his manly face, which promiseth
lines.plainText: And let his manly face which promiseth

lines.text: Successful fortune, steel thy melting heart
lines.plainText: Successful fortune steel thy melting heart

lines.text: To hold thine own and leave thine own with him.
lines.plainText: To hold thine own and leave thine own with him

lines.text: Full well hath Clifford played the orator,
lines.plainText: Full well hath Clifford played the orator

lines.text: Inferring arguments of mighty force.
lines.plainText: Inferring arguments of mighty force

lines.text: But, Clifford, tell me, didst thou never hear
lines.plainText: But Clifford tell me didst thou never hear

lines.text: That things ill got had ever bad success?
lines.plainText: That things ill got had ever bad success

lines.text: And happy always was it for that son
lines.plainText: And happy always was it for that son

lines.text: Whose father for his hoarding went to hell?
lines.plainText: Whose father for his hoarding went to hell

lines.text: I'll leave my son my virtuous deeds behind,
lines.plainText: I'll leave my son my virtuous deeds behind

lines.text: And would my father had left me no more;
lines.plainText: And would my father had left me no more

lines.text: For all the rest is held at such a rate
lines.plainText: For all the rest is held at such a rate

lines.text: As brings a thousand-fold more care to keep
lines.plainText: As brings a thousandfold more care to keep

lines.text: Than in possession any jot of pleasure.
lines.plainText: Than in possession any jot of pleasure

lines.text: Ah, cousin York, would thy best friends did know
lines.plainText: Ah cousin York would thy best friends did know

lines.text: How it doth grieve me that thy head is here!
lines.plainText: How it doth grieve me that thy head is here

lines.text: My lord, cheer up your spirits; our foes are nigh,
lines.plainText: My lord cheer up your spirits our foes are nigh

lines.text: And this soft courage makes your followers faint.
lines.plainText: And this soft courage makes your followers faint

lines.text: You promised knighthood to our forward son.
lines.plainText: You promised knighthood to our forward son

lines.text: Unsheathe your sword and dub him presently.—
lines.plainText: Unsheathe your sword and dub him presently

lines.text: Edward, kneel down.
lines.plainText: Edward kneel down

lines.text: Edward Plantagenet, arise a knight;
lines.plainText: Edward Plantagenet arise a knight

lines.text: And learn this lesson: draw thy sword in right.
lines.plainText: And learn this lesson draw thy sword in right

lines.text: My gracious father, by your kingly leave,
lines.plainText: My gracious father by your kingly leave

lines.text: I'll draw it as apparent to the crown,
lines.plainText: I'll draw it as apparent to the crown

lines.text: And in that quarrel use it to the death.
lines.plainText: And in that quarrel use it to the death

lines.text: Why, that is spoken like a toward prince.
lines.plainText: Why that is spoken like a toward prince

lines.text: Royal commanders, be in readiness;
lines.plainText: Royal commanders be in readiness

lines.text: For with a band of thirty thousand men
lines.plainText: For with a band of thirty thousand men

lines.text: Comes Warwick, backing of the Duke of York,
lines.plainText: Comes Warwick backing of the Duke of York

lines.text: And in the towns, as they do march along,
lines.plainText: And in the towns as they do march along

lines.text: Proclaims him king, and many fly to him.
lines.plainText: Proclaims him king and many fly to him

lines.text: Darraign your battle, for they are at hand.
lines.plainText: Darraign your battle for they are at hand

lines.text: I would your highness would depart the field.
lines.plainText: I would your highness would depart the field

lines.text: The Queen hath best success when you are absent.
lines.plainText: The Queen hath best success when you are absent

lines.text: Ay, good my lord, and leave us to our fortune.
lines.plainText: Ay good my lord and leave us to our fortune

lines.text: Why, that's my fortune too; therefore I'll stay.
lines.plainText: Why that's my fortune too therefore I'll stay

lines.text: Be it with resolution then to fight.
lines.plainText: Be it with resolution then to fight

lines.text: My royal father, cheer these noble lords,
lines.plainText: My royal father cheer these noble lords

lines.text: And hearten those that fight in your defence.
lines.plainText: And hearten those that fight in your defence

lines.text: Unsheathe your sword, good father; cry "Saint George!"
lines.plainText: Unsheathe your sword good father cry Saint George

content.text: March. Enter Edward, George, Richard, Warwick, Norfolk, Montague and Soldiers.

lines.text: Now, perjured Henry, wilt thou kneel for grace
lines.plainText: Now perjured Henry wilt thou kneel for grace

lines.text: And set thy diadem upon my head,
lines.plainText: And set thy diadem upon my head

lines.text: Or bide the mortal fortune of the field?
lines.plainText: Or bide the mortal fortune of the field

lines.text: Go rate thy minions, proud insulting boy!
lines.plainText: Go rate thy minions proud insulting boy

lines.text: Becomes it thee to be thus bold in terms
lines.plainText: Becomes it thee to be thus bold in terms

lines.text: Before thy sovereign and thy lawful king?
lines.plainText: Before thy sovereign and thy lawful king

lines.text: I am his king, and he should bow his knee.
lines.plainText: I am his king and he should bow his knee

lines.text: I was adopted heir by his consent.
lines.plainText: I was adopted heir by his consent

lines.text: Since when, his oath is broke; for, as I hear,
lines.plainText: Since when his oath is broke for as I hear

lines.text: You that are king, though he do wear the crown,
lines.plainText: You that are king though he do wear the crown

lines.text: Have caused him by new act of Parliament
lines.plainText: Have caused him by new act of Parliament

lines.text: To blot out me and put his own son in.
lines.plainText: To blot out me and put his own son in

lines.text: And reason too:
lines.plainText: And reason too

lines.text: Who should succeed the father but the son?
lines.plainText: Who should succeed the father but the son

lines.text: Are you there, butcher? O, I cannot speak!
lines.plainText: Are you there butcher O I cannot speak

lines.text: Ay, crook-back; here I stand, to answer thee,
lines.plainText: Ay crookback here I stand to answer thee

lines.text: Or any he, the proudest of thy sort.
lines.plainText: Or any he the proudest of thy sort

lines.text: 'Twas you that killed young Rutland, was it not?
lines.plainText: 'Twas you that killed young Rutland was it not

lines.text: Ay, and old York, and yet not satisfied.
lines.plainText: Ay and old York and yet not satisfied

lines.text: For God's sake, lords, give signal to the fight.
lines.plainText: For God's sake lords give signal to the fight

lines.text: What sayst thou, Henry, wilt thou yield the crown?
lines.plainText: What sayst thou Henry wilt thou yield the crown

lines.text: Why, how now, long-tongued Warwick, dare you speak?
lines.plainText: Why how now longtongued Warwick dare you speak

lines.text: When you and I met at Saint Albans last,
lines.plainText: When you and I met at Saint Albans last

lines.text: Your legs did better service than your hands.
lines.plainText: Your legs did better service than your hands

lines.text: Then 'twas my turn to fly, and now 'tis thine.
lines.plainText: Then 'twas my turn to fly and now 'tis thine

lines.text: You said so much before, and yet you fled.
lines.plainText: You said so much before and yet you fled

lines.text: 'Twas not your valour, Clifford, drove me thence.
lines.plainText: 'Twas not your valour Clifford drove me thence

lines.text: No, nor your manhood that durst make you stay.
lines.plainText: No nor your manhood that durst make you stay

lines.text: Northumberland, I hold thee reverently.
lines.plainText: Northumberland I hold thee reverently

lines.text: Break off the parley; for scarce I can refrain
lines.plainText: Break off the parley for scarce I can refrain

lines.text: The execution of my big-swoln heart
lines.plainText: The execution of my bigswoln heart

lines.text: Upon that Clifford, that cruel child-killer.
lines.plainText: Upon that Clifford that cruel childkiller

lines.text: I slew thy father; call'st thou him a child?
lines.plainText: I slew thy father call'st thou him a child

lines.text: Ay, like a dastard and a treacherous coward,
lines.plainText: Ay like a dastard and a treacherous coward

lines.text: As thou didst kill our tender brother Rutland,
lines.plainText: As thou didst kill our tender brother Rutland

lines.text: But ere sunset I'll make thee curse the deed.
lines.plainText: But ere sunset I'll make thee curse the deed

lines.text: Have done with words, my lords, and hear me speak.
lines.plainText: Have done with words my lords and hear me speak

lines.text: Defy them then, or else hold close thy lips.
lines.plainText: Defy them then or else hold close thy lips

lines.text: I prithee, give no limits to my tongue.
lines.plainText: I prithee give no limits to my tongue

lines.text: I am a king, and privileged to speak.
lines.plainText: I am a king and privileged to speak

lines.text: My liege, the wound that bred this meeting here
lines.plainText: My liege the wound that bred this meeting here

lines.text: Cannot be cured by words; therefore be still.
lines.plainText: Cannot be cured by words therefore be still

lines.text: Then, executioner, unsheathe thy sword.
lines.plainText: Then executioner unsheathe thy sword

lines.text: By Him that made us all, I am resolved
lines.plainText: By Him that made us all I am resolved

lines.text: That Clifford's manhood lies upon his tongue.
lines.plainText: That Clifford's manhood lies upon his tongue

lines.text: Say, Henry, shall I have my right, or no?
lines.plainText: Say Henry shall I have my right or no

lines.text: A thousand men have broke their fasts today
lines.plainText: A thousand men have broke their fasts today

lines.text: That ne'er shall dine unless thou yield the crown.
lines.plainText: That ne'er shall dine unless thou yield the crown

lines.text: If thou deny, their blood upon thy head;
lines.plainText: If thou deny their blood upon thy head

lines.text: For York in justice puts his armour on.
lines.plainText: For York in justice puts his armour on

lines.text: If that be right which Warwick says is right,
lines.plainText: If that be right which Warwick says is right

lines.text: There is no wrong, but everything is right.
lines.plainText: There is no wrong but everything is right

lines.text: Whoever got thee, there thy mother stands;
lines.plainText: Whoever got thee there thy mother stands

lines.text: For well I wot thou hast thy mother's tongue.
lines.plainText: For well I wot thou hast thy mother's tongue

lines.text: But thou art neither like thy sire nor dam,
lines.plainText: But thou art neither like thy sire nor dam

lines.text: But like a foul misshapen stigmatic,
lines.plainText: But like a foul misshapen stigmatic

lines.text: Marked by the Destinies to be avoided,
lines.plainText: Marked by the Destinies to be avoided

lines.text: As venom toads or lizards' dreadful stings.
lines.plainText: As venom toads or lizards' dreadful stings

lines.text: Iron of Naples, hid with English gilt,
lines.plainText: Iron of Naples hid with English gilt

lines.text: Whose father bears the title of a king,
lines.plainText: Whose father bears the title of a king

lines.text: As if a channel should be called the sea,
lines.plainText: As if a channel should be called the sea

lines.text: Sham'st thou not, knowing whence thou art extraught,
lines.plainText: Sham'st thou not knowing whence thou art extraught

lines.text: To let thy tongue detect thy base-born heart?
lines.plainText: To let thy tongue detect thy baseborn heart

lines.text: A wisp of straw were worth a thousand crowns
lines.plainText: A wisp of straw were worth a thousand crowns

lines.text: To make this shameless callet know herself.
lines.plainText: To make this shameless callet know herself

lines.text: Helen of Greece was fairer far than thou,
lines.plainText: Helen of Greece was fairer far than thou

lines.text: Although thy husband may be Menelaus;
lines.plainText: Although thy husband may be Menelaus

lines.text: And ne'er was Agamemnon's brother wronged
lines.plainText: And ne'er was Agamemnon's brother wronged

lines.text: By that false woman as this king by thee.
lines.plainText: By that false woman as this king by thee

lines.text: His father revelled in the heart of France,
lines.plainText: His father revelled in the heart of France

lines.text: And tamed the King, and made the Dauphin stoop;
lines.plainText: And tamed the King and made the Dauphin stoop

lines.text: And had he matched according to his state,
lines.plainText: And had he matched according to his state

lines.text: He might have kept that glory to this day;
lines.plainText: He might have kept that glory to this day

lines.text: But when he took a beggar to his bed
lines.plainText: But when he took a beggar to his bed

lines.text: And graced thy poor sire with his bridal day,
lines.plainText: And graced thy poor sire with his bridal day

lines.text: Even then that sunshine brewed a shower for him
lines.plainText: Even then that sunshine brewed a shower for him

lines.text: That washed his father's fortunes forth of France
lines.plainText: That washed his father's fortunes forth of France

lines.text: And heaped sedition on his crown at home.
lines.plainText: And heaped sedition on his crown at home

lines.text: For what hath broached this tumult but thy pride?
lines.plainText: For what hath broached this tumult but thy pride

lines.text: Hadst thou been meek, our title still had slept;
lines.plainText: Hadst thou been meek our title still had slept

lines.text: And we, in pity of the gentle king,
lines.plainText: And we in pity of the gentle king

lines.text: Had slipped our claim until another age.
lines.plainText: Had slipped our claim until another age

lines.text: But when we saw our sunshine made thy spring,
lines.plainText: But when we saw our sunshine made thy spring

lines.text: And that thy summer bred us no increase,
lines.plainText: And that thy summer bred us no increase

lines.text: We set the axe to thy usurping root;
lines.plainText: We set the axe to thy usurping root

lines.text: And though the edge hath something hit ourselves,
lines.plainText: And though the edge hath something hit ourselves

lines.text: Yet know thou, since we have begun to strike,
lines.plainText: Yet know thou since we have begun to strike

lines.text: We'll never leave till we have hewn thee down
lines.plainText: We'll never leave till we have hewn thee down

lines.text: Or bathed thy growing with our heated bloods.
lines.plainText: Or bathed thy growing with our heated bloods

lines.text: And in this resolution I defy thee;
lines.plainText: And in this resolution I defy thee

lines.text: Not willing any longer conference,
lines.plainText: Not willing any longer conference

lines.text: Since thou deniest the gentle King to speak.
lines.plainText: Since thou deniest the gentle King to speak

lines.text: Sound trumpets! Let our bloody colours wave;
lines.plainText: Sound trumpets Let our bloody colours wave

lines.text: And either victory or else a grave!
lines.plainText: And either victory or else a grave

lines.text: Stay, Edward.
lines.plainText: Stay Edward

lines.text: No, wrangling woman, we'll no longer stay.
lines.plainText: No wrangling woman we'll no longer stay

lines.text: These words will cost ten thousand lives this day.
lines.plainText: These words will cost ten thousand lives this day
